decisions.reason: As a newly launched but only lightly promoted niche workstation, it has some discontinuation risk if demand is modest, yet a large German machinery firm would usually give such industrial equipment more than one year to establish itself.

Its dedicated web presence suggests strategic importance in the firm's marking and coding portfolio, and a large established manufacturer would normally continue supporting a 2023 launch through 2024.

The product appears to be a serious portfolio offering with its own page, and although piezo systems can face narrower application fit and higher complexity, the firm is still likely to retain it while building market traction.
